inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Snack time was observed, and they served only one component (grains). The operation is required to offer two components for snacks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §744.2401(b))

occurrences.finding: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 5 Yrs and Older (1 1/2 hr): During the inspection, it was observed that a group consisting of 47 children was present and being supervised by one caregiver and one site director. However, the maximum permissible group size and the maximum number of children that 2 caregivers may supervise is 35 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 5 Yrs and Older (1 1/2 hr) (26 TAC §744.1609(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: The medication box was checked and all the medication available was not labeled with the child s full name and the date brought to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §744.2655(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children were seen consuming snacks without having their hands washed beforehand. This issue was addressed during the inspection when the caregivers were made aware of the rule, and they subsequently took the child to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §744.2517(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Documentation of two caregivers training was not accessible at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The fire drill for April 2026 was not conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §744.3559(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The monthly inspections of the active play area and equipment were not carried out in February, March, and April of 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §744.3113(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on the preponderance of the evidence, the operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation of Injury to a child in their care that requires medical treatment by a health-care professional within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior: Based on evidence obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver pushed a child on his chest as a form of redirection rather than using positive statements.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on evidence obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver didn't treat the children with respect, yelled at them, and was focused only on unacceptable behavior instead of using praise and encouragement for good behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language (26 TAC §744.2105(6))
